facts.fact: Felix 吓得尖叫求下降，Inara 却视骑龙为人生最刺激之事（她二十七岁）
facts.anchor: Flying on the back of a dragon the size of a fucking mountain was the most exciting thing to ever happen to her in all her life

facts.fact: 空中俯瞰到家乡 Deadhaven：破败房屋环绕一条魔法催生的细小水流
facts.anchor: Inara spotted her village, Deadhaven. A cluster of worn-out, broken-down homes

facts.fact: 四王国守护兽设定展开：Roylan 独眼巨人、Pregon 蛇怪、Arelia 巨龙、亡国狮鹫
facts.anchor: For Arelia, the heart of the realm, it was a monstrous dragon.

facts.fact: Inara 无王室血统，是被三王国鄙夷的 Border Rat（靠偷骗活着）
facts.anchor: She was a Border Rat, born and bred in the Borderlands

facts.fact: 村民以为是 Arelian 军队来袭，村中三醉汉（雷电/念力/怪力）抬手要攻击
facts.anchor: Ralf, Lina, and Zave threw their hands up, preparing to attack.

facts.fact: 巨龙要对村民喷火时 Inara 喊停，龙竟听懂了她——心灵感应开始显现
facts.anchor: Somehow—she had no idea how—the dragon heard her plea. Understood her.

facts.fact: Venerable Cias 点破守护兽是 Crowned Family 财产，命她立刻送回并召她去 librarium
facts.anchor: It is the property of the Crowned Family. Once they find out you have it, they will come here.

facts.fact: 结尾测试取名（Bobby/Harris 都被否）后，龙的心识如蛇般在她脑中游走
facts.anchor: Feel another consciousness in her head, moving around, slithering in and out like a snake.
